quote: we propose an inference-time attention head masking mechanism that works on encoder-decoder attentions to underscore salient content from the source and improve the quality of abstractive summaries.
We adopt large pre‑trained sequence‑to‑sequence Transformer models (BART, specifically) for abstractive summarization ...

guideline: Informativeness measures how well the summary captures salient content from the article, while faithfulness indicates whether the summary correctly reflects the content in the source article.
Annotators judge each summary on informativeness (how well it captures salient content) and faithfulness (whether it correctly reflects source content).
The annotators are asked to determine if attention head masking improves any of the two aspects.
